name: Python Static Security Analysis (management rendition)
description: Run Bandit static security analysis over the InTrust tool layer to identify insecure coding patterns before release. Reported as a release decision.

reporting.expectedOutput: Release verdict and the highest-severity issues, without the full issue list

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_python_scan_technical.json with the same target, parameters and criteria. This is the clearest case in the sample set for why reportProfile.findingsOmitted exists: all four findings against ./tools are LOW and the management floor is MEDIUM, so the rendition's findings list is empty while canonicalFindingCount is 4 and findingsOmitted is 4. An empty list with the count beside it reads as 'nothing at decision level'; the same empty list without it would read as 'nothing at all'.
